question: When you pick a recording that fills the frame and is not zoomed, should it show resize handles?
context: The zoom walkthrough (video-zoom-wt.html, frameRing) rings the clip and shows no handles at every step. The app now rings a recording only while it is pushed in past the frame.

options.label: Handles at its own size, ring when zoomed
options.summary: At the wide shot a picked recording shows its blue box and eight handles, like any picture. Once it is pushed in past the frame the box becomes a ring on the frame with no handles.
pros: You can still shrink a recording into a corner by its handles, picture-in-picture style
cons: The look of the pick changes as you scrub into a push
Differs from the zoom walkthrough, which never shows handles on the clip
options.mitigation: The ring sits exactly where the box was, so only the eight small squares come and go.

options.label: Always a ring, never handles
options.summary: A picked recording that fills the frame always shows a ring on the frame and no handles, zoomed or not, as the walkthrough draws it. Size and framing change through Scale and by dragging the picture.
pros: Matches the mock at every step
The pick looks the same however far in you are
cons: Shrinking a full-frame recording into a corner needs the Scale row rather than a corner drag
options.mitigation: Scale and dragging the picture still do it, and a recording smaller than the frame keeps its handles.
